opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid OneCoin packages ranging from 100 to 5,000 euros, then ties earnings directly to recruiting purchasers: a referral for $500 is said to produce a $50 bonus. It describes a two-sided team structure in which recruits follow on the left or right, making the income opportunity dependent on building a network. The presentation further encourages holding the promoted package or coins for 24 months by projecting account values from 96,000 to possibly half a million euros. It concludes with a direct recommendation to partner with the team, alongside a signup destination for the opportunity. These features present recruitment-based commissions, binary team compensation, and highly lucrative future values as reasons to participate.
